title: National University Of Sciences and Technology Amendment Act 2016

sections.shortTitle: National University Of Sciences and Technology Amendment Act 2016
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXIII OF 2016
ACT XXIII OF 2016
NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF
SCIENCES AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An Act to amend the
National University of Sciences and Technology Act, 1997
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 10th May, 2016]
No. F. 9(8)/2016-Legis, dated 9-5-2016.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 4th
May, 2016 and is hereby published for general information:--
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the National University of
Sciences and Technology Act 1997 (No. XX of 1997) for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the National University of Sciences and Technology (Amendment)
Act, 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

No. F. 9(8)/2016-Legis, dated 9-5-2016.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 4th
May, 2016 and is hereby published for general information:--
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the National University of
Sciences and Technology Act 1997 (No. XX of 1997) for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment of section 10, Act XX of 1997.---In the National
University of Sciences and Technology Act, 1997 (No. XX of 1997) in section 10,
in subsection (1), for the words "engineering qualifications and
experience" the words "qualifications and experience as prescribed by
the Board", shall be substituted.
